hook: Android 17, running inside an iPhone app

beats.say: Nestvane is a new open-source project that runs a full Android 17 system inside an ordinary iOS app, with no JIT and no jailbreak.
iOS bans executable memory, so Android is translated ahead of time and paired with a Linux kernel layer written for the app.
On an iPhone 17 Pro it reaches the home screen in about ten seconds and plays 720p video at 30 frames per second. It's developer-only for now.
